belief: I keep the words that help me grow.
title: Helpful Words Listening Badge
subtitle: Make a badge that reminds you to sift helpful words from noise.

materials: tape or a safety pin with adult help
steps: Colour the badge and circle the helpful sentence.
Cut out the badge on the solid cut line.
Cross out the noisy words you want to let go.
Wear or display the badge where you will see it.
content.take_it_today: When you hear mixed messages, point to your badge and keep the helpful part.

wisdom.statement: Ganesha's ears teach us to keep helpful words and let noisy words fall away.
wisdom.today: Choose one helpful sentence to repeat to yourself when noise appears.
